purpose: Small source-frozen independent falsification of one fixed continuous R/tau box, retained SOC/capacity learning and source-level all-prefix width premises; separately interpreted frozen SCM_FULL comparison.
model_scope: At most one uncertain RC mode with fixed real R/tau anywhere in integer-endpoint boxes. Other RC/R0 and encoded monotone PWL OCV are known. Exact represented current/time, static unknown SOC0/Q, hard supplied voltage interval; no hysteresis or drift. Shared interval propagation discards nuisance correlations and does not learn R/tau.

public_configuration.capacity_edges: 30000+floor(70000*k/64), k=0..64; adjacent closed bins overlap at their boundary
public_configuration.support_difference: The integer SOC prior outwardly encloses the frozen reference prior[0.2,0.95] with at most one grid-unit expansion. Reference capacity support[0.03,0.10]Ah matches.
public_configuration.OCV_origin: Nodes rounded once from the public illustration3+1.15*z+0.08*tanh(8*(z-0.5)) at z=k/8. The listed encoded PWL itself is the exact declared model; no approximation-to-tanh guarantee is used.
public_configuration.uncertainty_origin: Predeclared +/-10% stress uncertainty around stability003 PUBLIC slow mode R60mOhm,tau30s, chosen before numerical development. Not calibrated and not built from hidden synthetic truth. The listed degenerate nominal model remains the public control.

stimulus_scope: 3675 samples,105s, nominal35Hz, four phase endpoints. Synthetic numerical laboratory use;120mA charging is not a hardware pulse recommendation.

generator_and_scorer_only.truth_rule: Truth is used only to generate observations and score containment/error. It is absent from inference configuration, cell bounds, centers, starts and state corrections.
generator_and_scorer_only.noise_recipe_nV: (((sample_index*48271+17)%1801)-900)*1000; deterministic amplitude<=900000nV. Round the midpoint of the independent noiseless-voltage enclosure to the nearest integer nV, ties upward, then add this perturbation. Certify the full noiseless enclosure lies inside center+-1000000nV.
generator_and_scorer_only.oracle: Exact Fraction charge/SOC/PWL plus independent positive-series exponential bounds from audit_stable.py, outward quantized to a2^-128 coefficient/state grid. No C provider state or synthetic true correction enters inference.
generator_and_scorer_only.raw_trace_policy: The committed deterministic recipe reconstructs every observation; record canonical input hashes and small checkpoints rather than storing a redundant raw trace.
generator_and_scorer_only.selected_R_tau_truth_rule: Each case uses its listed exact rational constant R/tau solely inside the independent observation generator and scorer. They do not change the public uncertain provider configuration, cells, starts or corrections.

required_audits: At every main-case sample: all closed bins containing truth remain active; retained SOC0 intervals, currentSOC hull and capacity hull contain truth; charge equals the exact represented sum; independent RC states are enclosed; generated voltage interval contains independent noiseless voltage.
Active masks are subsets of their predecessors; active retained SOC0 intervals never widen; inactive intervals remain frozen.
At zero-current rest, charge is unchanged and persistent currentSOC/capacity query widths do not increase.
Unexcited zero-charge prefix retains the full capacity domain; informative and renewed phases strictly narrow capacity width and the persistent evidence measure compared with their preceding phase.
Boundary truth at Q=65000microAh retains both adjacent closed capacity bins; same observation protocol, shortened deterministic exercise.
Positive, negative and return-to-zero charge; PWL knots and plateaus; SOC-domain clipping; invalid full-transaction atomicity; explicit contradictory voltage and sticky inconsistency.
A deliberately uninformative quiet interval preserves all earlier mask/SOC0 evidence while RC states relax.
Outward query endpoints agree with an independent exact rational hull of the stored per-bin state; query reads no latest-only voltage shortcut.

Public midpoint and all four R/tau box corners each receive the complete predeclared four-phase sequence. Every exact truth-containing capacity bin survives, every retained SOC0/query and RC interval encloses the independent Fraction/dyadic oracle at every sample.
One short fractional interior R/tau trace certifies continuous parameter semantics; one fixed true parameter pair per trajectory, without parameter learning or truth-supplied corrections.

Degenerate public midpoint box control consumes exactly the same midpoint observations as the uncertain provider and matches the frozen003 C provider numerical state, result and status after every sample. No old campaign is rerun.

Direct attenuation/helper canaries include signed forcing, eight exact rational corners, identity after validation, reversed targets invalid even at identity, tau endpoints1 andUINT32_MAX, q>=32 across tau endpoints and atomic destination failure.
Invalid boxes, reversed R/tau endpoints, zero tau, physical forcing bound failures and more than one nondegenerate mode reject complete initialization atomically.

All-time width coefficients and separate arithmetic/model contributions are derived from the declared future tick/current alphabet, using exact unbounded integer/Fraction arithmetic rather than a finite-trace extrapolation.

Independently verify the exact public unit-transform identities over the declared tick/current alphabet and public RC parameter endpoints, including charge/currentSOC and predicted RC forcing/attenuation equivalence. No synthetic truth supplied.

For each declared positive tick and zero, certify midpoint degenerate attenuation is contained in the boxed enclosure. At every midpoint trace prefix, the nominal provider RC/mask/activeSOC0/currentSOC/capacity support is contained in the uncertain provider support; this conditional coefficient-alphabet check is not assumed globally.

usefulness_gates.capacity_unexcited: Capacity width equals the complete declared prior after the initial zero-charge phase.
usefulness_gates.informative_phases: Strict capacity-hull narrowing and strict decrease of total active SOC0 interval widths after each informative phase relative to the immediately preceding phase endpoint. No post hoc threshold selection.
usefulness_gates.quiet_phase: Persistent cell/SOC0 evidence and currentSOC/capacity hull widths do not widen at zero current.
usefulness_gates.precision_policy: Report actual ranges. No new arbitrary SOC/Q target threshold and no Gaussian confidence interpretation. A failed usefulness gate remains recorded and is not repaired by silently changing the plan.
usefulness_gates.per_case: Apply every four-phase gate separately to public midpoint and each corner. Preserve/report each failure with actual widths and width ratios relative to the main public degenerate control; no retuning to pass.

width_analysis.recurrence: W_next <= Ahi*W/D + (D-Alo)*F/D + 2B*(Ahi-Alo)/D + 2, with W<=2B and exact unity identities unchanged.
width_analysis.definitions: D=2^32; g=min(D-Ahi)>0; h=max(Ahi-Alo); b=max(D-Alo); Fmax=max_current |I|*(Rhi-Rlo); W0=initial interval width.
width_analysis.all_prefix_bound: min(2B,max(W0,(b*Fmax+2B*h+2D)/g)). All numerators are exact Python integers/Fractions.
width_analysis.current_scope: Endpoint enumeration certifies all integer represented currents in[-200000,200000] by monotonicity of |I|. The trace itself uses only0 and-120000.
width_analysis.uncertainty_decomposition: Report coefficient model-span enclosures from an independent exact positive-series oracle, endpoint-kernel overenclosure, forcing-width contribution, coefficient-span contribution and integer endpoint-rounding contribution separately. Degenerate model contribution is zero. The finite observed width is distinct from the analytic all-prefix bound.
width_analysis.nominal_containment: If uncertain-vs-degenerate nesting is reported, explicitly check coefficient containment on every declared active tick and exact zero-time identity; generic numerical kernel nesting is not assumed.
width_analysis.scope: The theorem requires the unchanged model/domain and future alphabet. No empirical lifetime extrapolation or physical error validation.

retained_history_comparison.source: Unchanged src/scm_estimator.c with SCM_FULL and same public OCV/known parameters/observations.
retained_history_comparison.known_parameters: Fix other twoRC R/tau, R0, all supplied initialRC states, H=u0=0, irrelevant gammas100. Selected R/tau plusSOC0/logQ remain free; no synthetic truth reaches solver inputs or initial guesses.
retained_history_comparison.public_starts: Three unchanged scm_default_theta starts; no supplied selected R/tau starting values. Linear R is fitted through existing variable projection. These are unchanged internal solver-coordinate starts; physical tau starts change by the public scale2 transform.

feasible_set_difference.reason: Frozen API exposes fixed masks but no adjustable bounds. Public exact unit transform scales time/current and known RC parameters so its broader physical support contains the complete certificate R/tau box. The supports remain unequal; this is a retained-history diagnostic, not an equivalent constrained fit.

retained_history_comparison.cases: Main public midpoint observations only; corner traces test certificate soundness, not reference support.
retained_history_comparison.outputs: Numerical convergence/termination separately from call return; selected R/tau,SOC0/currentSOC/Q points and post-fit scorer errors; objective/projected gradient; raw conditional scaled4x4 Gram in coordinates[logtau_slow,SOC0,logQ,R_slow]; scales, symmetric eigenvalues, rank and condition; memory and CPU.
retained_history_comparison.local_diagnostic: 4x4 Gram conditions on fixed known parameters. Eigenvalues/conditioning are ordinary floating point at returned local fit, not global identification, provider coverage, a posterior or uncertainty propagation. Internal linear R scale0.2ohm corresponds to physical0.4ohm; logtau offset is constant so its differential is unchanged. No marginal SOC/Q precision is inferred from its subblock while R/tau remain free.
retained_history_comparison.rank_rule: Eigenvalue rank relative threshold1e-12*max_abs_eigenvalue; nonpositive/singular condition is reported explicitly, never as finite precision.
retained_history_comparison.interpretation: Return success and numerical convergence are separate. Point inclusion in a hard outer hull is descriptive, not a provider-soundness gate. Local precision and statistical coverage remain separate; no Gaussian coverage on the bounded trace is claimed.

public_unit_transform.physical_output_conversion: Reported fit R/tau and elapsed physical time multiply internal values by2. Charge,capacity,SOC and objective unchanged. Raw Gram remains in explicitly labelled internal scaled coordinates.

resource_accounting: sizeof complete caller-owned configuration, bank, staged workspace, input and output; all core compiler stack frames; static object sections; undefined imports; no heap/libm in provider. Include configuration backing storage. Report host own-source subtotal and unresolved target/runtime/interrupt costs separately. Compare complete provider-owned objects and own-source stack/sections/imports against frozen retained-history allocation fields with explicit different scopes; complete firmware resources remain unqualified.

execution_policy.development: Allowed only to a new output outside the repository, explicitly labeled development; development checks precede the primary source freeze.
execution_policy.primary: Only after root supplies --source-revision and all listed source/plan files byte-match that committed source revision. Refuse an existing output; check all old source/tools/proofs/results/evidence hashes before and after. Preserve failed usefulness or reference gates.
execution_policy.frozen_evidence: No old source, result or experiment may change. No old campaign rerun.
execution_policy.source_freeze: Numerical choices and gates are frozen in this plan before numerical development; final source and proof files freeze before one primary run. Development adaptations and failures are disclosed separately.
execution_policy.result_semantics: Execution completion, mandatory soundness, usefulness, reference completion, and overall acceptance are distinct receipt fields. A failed usefulness gate does not erase completed evidence or authorize tuning.

design_decisions_before_development.decision: Public scale2 reference unit transform covers entire selected parameter box within unchanged frozen solver bounds.
design_decisions_before_development.reason: Initial direct physical-coordinate proposal would have excluded tau>30s. Chosen before numerical development; no failed numerical result or test-driven tuning.
